title: ops-dartboard-lightweight-handback-matrix-may-2033
content:
Purpose: quick one-page tracker to coordinate single-day coverage swaps and handbacks across regions when an unexpected surge or runway shift hits. Used for same-day decisions; not canonical rota. Keep short, sync in Slack, update after handoff.

Context: yesterday’s feature release pushed more online conversion tests than expected during EU morning. We needed quick coverage rebalances and a handful of fallbacks (smaller model variants) while Dedicated pools warmed up. This sheet captures the minimal info to make the call and confirm ownership.

Snapshot table (columns: owner | primary | backup | region | window | expected load | current mitigation):
Ava Thompson | SRE-primary | Rafael Ortiz | us-west | 09:00-13:00 PDT | +35% token/s | burst-queue=on; fallback=rw-compact-v1
Maya Singh | PE-primary | Jordan Lee | eu-west | 15:00-19:00 CET | +50% chat sessions | route-to-dedicated-capacity; cache-ttl 30s
Priya Narayanan | Prod-primary | Ava Thompson | ap-south | 02:00-06:00 IST | +20% embeddings | quantized-embed-run; throttling policy applied

Quick checks (tick when done):
- [ ] Confirmed backups paged? -> who paged (slack msg)
- [ ] Model fallbacks configured in routing policy
- [ ] Autoscale headroom verified (X GPUs free)
- [ ] Cost guardrails temporarily relaxed? (yes/no)

Notes to self / ephemeral decisions:
- If eu-west sustained >45% for 20m, switch chat-route to ded pool B (pool id in Confluence).
- For us-west spike, keep prefix-cache warm for top-10 prefixes; Rafael to upload primes to KV cache.
- APAC embedding bursts: switch quantized-embed-run only while ded capacity is cold; revert after 1h.

Open questions / follow-ups:
- Should we schedule an ops retro this week to capture what triggered the conversion spike? Owner: Maya.
- Do we need pre-warm playbooks for night-zone APAC customers (Priya to propose short checklist).

Post-mortem anchors (to fill after incident):
- Timeline (UTC): start, mitigations, restore, cost impact estimate, leftover risks.
- Action owners and due dates.

References & quick links:
- Confluence playbook (handback) — /display/OPS/Handback+Playbook
- Dash: real-time token/s by region -> link (internal dash id: tokens-regional-live)
- JIRA ops ticket: OPS-7893 (tracking this one-off)

Quick log (running):
2023-05-02 16:12 UTC - spike detected eu-west +52% - Maya triaged; chat-route shifted 16:18 UTC
2023-05-02 16:32 UTC - fallback in place: rw-compact-v1; latency improved ~18%
2023-05-02 17:05 UTC - Dedicated pool warmed, routing reverted 17:07 UTC

TL;DR: short-lived surge handled by temporary routing and quantized backups. Use this doc for fast handoff notes; copy relevant lines into the incident ticket and close within 48h.
content_warning: lightly formatted, checklist style; includes shorthand and quick decision notes
